notes.subject: khomelo
notes.rationale: כפר — khomelo ya go lokolla, sehlabelo sa go fišwa; KJV 'ransom', dikgati tše dingwe 'atonement'.

notes.subject: פדעהו
notes.rationale: פדע 'go lokolla' — lentšu le lekae kudu go Tanakh, go bontšha go lokollwa go ya kgethegilego.

notes.subject: yo a bolelago
notes.rationale: Sebopego sa go bolela se hloka yo a bolelago — Elohim ke yena a re 'Mo lokolole', gomme⟨yo a bolelago⟩ga e ngwalwe.

translation: gomme a mo kgotsofetše, a re: Mo lokolole go theoga go ya phatleng; ke hweditše khomelo.
